name: @latticekit/example-harbor
description: HARBOR — a gallery exhibit. Tall thin objects and depth sorting: masts, cranes, and a jetty over water.
$comment: Six of nine. `sim` and `persist` are absent because a harbor with no economy and nothing that outlives the tab needs neither; `audio` is absent for the reason every other exhibit gives — the gallery still has no shared answer for the gesture that unlocks an AudioContext, and a working harbor is the exhibit that most wants a gull and a hull creak. `loop` and `input` arrive through examples/_shared's bootstrap and are named here because they are what this runs on.
